_readme: Asset manifest. Files live in public/ and are referenced here by path relative to public/. Every entry needs source + caption + alt. Fields in [brackets] are placeholders to verify.

twoPhoton.title: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging, hippocampal CA1
twoPhoton.playback: 4× real time (60 s of recording in a 15 s clip)

recordings.label: BL6
recordings.description: [Genotype description — to verify, e.g. wild-type C57BL/6]
recordings.alt: Greyscale two-photon movie of densely packed CA1 pyramidal neurons; individual cells brighten briefly when active. Timestamp top left, scale bar bottom left.

twoPhotonRois.title: From pixels to activity traces
twoPhotonRois.caption: Five regions of interest (coloured circles) mark individual neurons. Their fluorescence changes (ΔF/F) are plotted on the right as the movie plays: each peak is a calcium transient reflecting a burst of activity.
twoPhotonRois.alt: Two-photon movie with five coloured circles around neurons next to a plot of five ΔF/F traces over time that builds up as the movie plays.

ihc.title: Amyloid plaques and CA1 in APP23xPS45 mice
ihc.source: Zott et al. (2024) Nat Commun, Supplementary Fig. S13A — reproduced under CC BY 4.0
ihc.note: Extracted from the supplementary PDF (≈ 900 px wide). Replace with original high-resolution confocal files or .dzi tiles for full deep zoom.

sections.label: 2.5 months
sections.alt: Confocal image of a coronal brain slice from a 2.5-month-old APP23xPS45 mouse in grey, with an enlarged inset of the CA1 pyramidal layer. Almost no cyan plaques.
sections.caption: Young APP23xPS45 mouse (2.5 months): no plaques yet. Scale bars 1000 µm (slice) and 100 µm (inset).

hotspots.label: Hippocampus, CA1
hotspots.text: The boxed region marks the CA1 area enlarged in the inset.

hotspots.label: Stratum pyramidale
hotspots.text: The bright band is the densely packed layer of CA1 pyramidal cell bodies — the cells we image in vivo.

sections.label: 8.0 months
sections.alt: Confocal image of a coronal brain slice from an 8-month-old APP23xPS45 mouse with numerous cyan amyloid plaques throughout cortex and hippocampus; inset shows plaques around the CA1 pyramidal layer.
sections.caption: Old APP23xPS45 mouse (8.0 months): numerous Methoxy-X04-positive plaques (cyan). Scale bars 1000 µm (slice) and 100 µm (inset).

hotspots.label: Cortical plaques
hotspots.text: Each cyan dot is a β-amyloid plaque labelled with Methoxy-X04.

hotspots.label: Hippocampus, CA1
hotspots.text: The boxed region marks the CA1 area enlarged in the inset.

hotspots.label: Plaques around CA1
hotspots.text: In the inset, plaques surround the CA1 pyramidal layer — the plaque stage, when anticalin treatment no longer reduced hyperactivity (Zott et al., 2024).
